ordered_cell_evaluation.reason: No disclosed material acquisition-related goodwill or contractual-right impairment; Runwu Jiaye's disclosed profit contribution is positive; its 9.04% profit return is not below 5%; and the annual report does not disclose a further FY2024 large acquisition outside the pre-frozen Shouzhishenghua and Runwu Jiaye scope.
The pre-frozen Shouzhishenghua acquisition has no separately disclosed FY2024 profit or operating-cash contribution; therefore the all-in-scope-acquisitions disclosure requirement is not complete.

The same missing Shouzhishenghua contribution prevents the required at-least-one-attributable-contribution disclosure for every in-scope acquisition. Runwu Jiaye's missing operating-cash contribution cannot be treated as zero or selected against its disclosed positive profit contribution.

At least one pre-frozen material acquisition — Shouzhishenghua — has neither a separately disclosed FY2024 profit contribution nor operating-cash contribution, while no independent sufficient J3-negative event is disclosed.

axis_settlements.axis_limited_conclusion: The annual report supplies a positive 9.04% FY2024 profit return for Runwu Jiaye but not its operating-cash contribution, and supplies neither contribution measure for Shouzhishenghua. This local disclosure gap cannot be filled with group operating cash, overall profit, related-party collections, no impairment, or the disclosed Runwu Jiaye profit contribution.
